info.title: FinaMetrica Profiler
info.description: Get questions and response options for risk tolerance, experience, and know your client questionnaires. Submit questionnaire responses to get data that can be used to calculate suitability scores for a client. Get a specific questionnaire response or the entire response history for a client. Submit new and access existing professional judgement matrices.

get.description: Get questions and possible options for the Risk Tolerance questionnaire.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Indicate the locale for the request. e.g. en-US, fr-CA

post.summary: Create unique identifier for a client
post.description: Create a unique identifier for a client. You use this alphanumeric ID to identify your client within FinaMetrica. You must include the ID when submitting and retrieving a client's responses. The ID is generated based on the `externalId` (for example, client's email address) that is sent in the request. If your client already has an ID, you do not need to generate a new one. The ID will never expire.

Submit a client’s responses to the risk tolerance questionnaire and return a risk tolerance score. In the response, a unique identifier for the questionnaire will be returned. The identifier can be used to retrieve the answers at any time in the future.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Indicate the locale for the request. e.g. en-US, fr-CA

get.description: Get questionnaire responses for the client identified by the value in the `clientId` parameter. You can retrieve a list of all the responses the client has given to past questionnaires.
